compilation.validationScope: 結構、引用與明示規則檢查；不證明算法精度或效能。

coverage.scope: Attempted units with human-confirmed expected categories; unattempted pending units are not in this denominator.

regression.metricsScope: precision/recall/falsePositiveRate use completed, valid classifications with human-confirmed expected categories only; FAULT/CANCELLED/unavailable classifications are excluded from the confusion matrix. endToEndDetectionRate uses attempted expected-positive units including unavailable outcomes. Neither is independent industrial accuracy or acceptance.

execution.cancellationPolicy: between-node; active worker finishes or its configured timeout terminates it

viewTiming.scope: UI refresh wall time, may overlap native execution; do not add to unit time

timing.cycleScope: unit-start to durable-save completion (or classification completion without durable save); includes host dispatch and persistence, excludes subsequent UI presentation and inter-unit delay
timing.scope: batch wall elapsed including host callbacks and inter-unit UI work; not a sum of operator durations
